senses.gloss:
खट् खट्, cl. 1. P. खटति, &c., to desire,
wish, seek or inquire.

खट्ट् खट्ट्, cl. 10. P. खट्टयति, -यितुम्,
to cover, to screen.

खाट् खाट्, ind. (an onomatopoetic word),
the sound made in clearing the throat; [cf. खात्.]

खट, अस्, m. (fr. rt. खट् above?), phlegm, the
phlegmatic or watery humor [cf. कफ]; a blind
well; an axe, a hatchet [cf. टङ्क]; a plough; a
kind of blow or wound; the closed or doubled fist
(as for striking &c.); grass; a coarse long grass of
several species used to thatch houses [cf. कट and
खड]; a fragrant kind of grass.
—खट-कटाहक,
अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), a spitting-box.
—खट-
खादक, अस्, m. (?), an eater; a glass vessel; a
jackal; an animal; a crow.

खट्टा खट्टा, f. a bedstead; a kind of grass,
Andropogon Serratus; (a wrong reading for खट्वा.)

खाट खाट, अस्, आ, m. f. a bier, a cot or
bedstead on which dead bodies are conveyed to the
pile; [cf. खट्टि.]

खटक, अस्, m. a go-between, a man whose
business is to negociate marriages [cf. घटक]; the
half-closed hand; the doubled fist of wrestlers or
boxers.
—खटका-मुख, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?),
a particular position of the hand in shooting; (अस्),
m. a man in the attitude of shooting.

खटिक, अस्, m. the hand half-closed, the fist;
(आ), f. chalk [cf. कक्खटी, कठिनी, &c.]; the ex-
ternal opening of the ear; the plant Andropogon
Muricatus.

खट्टिक खट्टिक, अस्, m. a butcher, a hunter,
a fowler, one who lives by killing and selling game;
the cream on the milk of a buffalo-cow; (आ), f. a
small bedstead, a cot; a bier or bed on which the
corpse is carried.
खाटिका, f. a bier; [cf. खट्टिका.]

खटक्किका खटक्किका, f. a side door; [cf.
खडक्किका.]

खटखटाय खटखटाय (an onomatopoetic
word), A. -टायते, -यितुम्, to spring or issue forth
with a noise.

खटिनी खटिनी or खटी, f. chalk; (some
books read खठिनी); [cf. कठिनी, खटिक.]

खटू खटू (?), an ornament worn on the
wrist or ancle.

खट्टन खट्टन, अस्, m. a dwarf [cf. खट्टे-
रक]; (अस्, आ, अम्), dwarfish, short of stature.

खट्टाश खट्टाश, अस्, m. the civet or zebet
cat, Viverra Zibetha; (ई), f. the same or (according
to another authority) a different animal; (some write
the word खट्टास.)

खट्टि खट्टि, इस्, ई, m. f. a bier, the bed on
which the corpse is carried to the pile.
खाटि, इस्, f. a bier; a scar; caprice, whim.

खट्टेरक खट्टेरक, अस्, आ, अम्, dwarfish,
dwarf; [cf. खट्टन.]

खट्वा खट्वा, f. (said to be fr. rt. खट्), a
bedstead, a couch, a cot; a swing, a hammock; a
kind of bandage; N. of a plant, = कोलशिम्बी.
—ख-
ट्वाङ्ग (˚वा-अङ्˚), अस्, m. a club shaped like the foot
of a bedstead,’ i. e. a club or staff with a skull at the
top considered as the weapon of Śiva and carried by
ascetics and Yogis; wood from a funeral pile; N. of
a king of the solar line, = Dilīpa; (ई), f., N. of a
river.
—खट्वाङ्ग-धार, अस्, m. or खट्वाङ्ग-
भृत्, त्, m. ‘staff-bearer,’ an epithet of Śiva.
—खट्वाङ्ग-वन, अम्, n., N. of a forest.
—ख-
ट्वाङ्गिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having the staff described above; (ई),
m. an epithet of Śiva.
—खट्वाप्लुत (˚वा-आप्˚) or
खट्वारूढ (˚वा-आर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, mounted on a
bed, lying on a bed: low, vile, abandoned, iniquitous;
erring, going wrong; silly, stupid.
खट्विका, f. a small bedstead.

खाट्वाभारिक खाट्वाभारिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr.
खट्वा-भार), or खाट्विक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. खट्वा),
laden with bedsteads.
